title: Dev-only development, complete software regression and protected QA/main live qualification
user_story: The owner develops with AI on dev, verifies locally, then promotes through qa to main using honest phase-specific evidence.

requirements.description: Coverage informational; every selected mandatory regression executes and passes, invalid/missing/skip never passes
Source commits only dev; local complete source-bound report before authorized origin dev push; only forward promotion
Only exact three declared live IDs deferred as NOT_RUN on dev; real complete evidence required at QA/main
Mandatory offline official SDK tests run with pinned/hash-verified dependency; untrusted archive cannot escape or overwrite
Declared upstream license text uses LF normalization so identical Git source has the same canonical identity on Windows and Linux.

nonfunctional: Preserve user work, history, all skills/ and agent/ files
Only owner-authorized qualified native forward auto-merge; never bypass protected QA
At most three persistent repair invocations; only the separately owner-granted single600second/six-step Spark UAT exception may exceed the old exhausted UAT ledger
Bound archive download/inventory; no arbitrary CLI/log instruction execution
outputs: Measured informational coverage and explicit deferred test records
preconditions: Trusted dev worktree and reviewed owner policy
postconditions: No mandatory software skip/FAIL becomes PASS
QA/main missing live evidence remains blocked
acceptance_criteria: Required software regression executes/PASS100% without coverage percentage threshold
SDK installation fails closed on changed/unsafe archive

scenarios.expected: Complete regression passes regardless of measured/missing coverage
Only dev mutation and forward promotion
Stale or incomplete software verification blocks push
Only authorized origin repository may receive push
Actual latest failing receipt invalidates previous green in isolated Git repository
Software layer never invokes the declared live cases
Wrong digest or escaping paths cannot write files
Extract exactly reviewed files and preserve existing output
LF/CRLF and staging preserve identity; real license content changes invalidate evidence.

recovery: Preserve raw failures and state. Repair only confirmed root cause on dev, maximum3 invocations; no ledger resets or fake evidence.
test_environment: Explicit offline policy fixtures, isolated actual Git repositories and bounded archive fixtures. MOCKED aggregate does not certify remote GitHub/AI execution.

review.method: Same-agent adversarial review; not independent certification

tdd.scope: Actual initial nine-case run: coverage behavior failed and missing new interfaces errored; missing interfaces are not called functional reproduction. Subsequent actual complete policy/guard suite passes. Locale unit RED/GREEN and actual SDK software results are separate raw records.
